newsitem.title: ITALY: Specialists bid for 3-year and 5-year BTPs.
newsitem.headline: Specialists bid for 3-year and 5-year BTPs.

text.p: Specialist bond traders bid for 311 billion lire of three-year fixed-rate bonds (BTP) against the Italian Treasury's offer of 200 billion lire of paper.
Earlier, the Treasury received bids for 4.430 trillion lire at the open auction for the May 15, 2000 paper, against two trillion lire worth of BTPs on offer.
The auction price was set at 98.75 from 99.60 at the previous BTP sale on May 16.
There were also bids for 635 billion lire of five-year BTPs against an offer of 300 billion of paper.
The Treasury had earlier received bids for 5.290 trillion lire at the open auction of the May 15 2002 paper against three trillion lire of BTPs on offer. The auction price was set at 97.75.
